多智能体系统

[MA-0] Replication of Agent ic Security Events: Audit and Investigation (ROGUE-AI)

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前生成式AI代理（Generative AI Agents）在实际应用中因安全缺陷导致的故障事件难以被有效复现与根因分析的问题。现有媒体报道和事故目录仅记录“发生了什么”，却缺乏对事件是否真实发生、其根本原因是否被正确识别的验证，且无法通过可重复实验检验潜在漏洞。针对这一缺口，论文提出ROGUE-AI（Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation）——一种多智能体复现框架，能够在线下重建每个已报告的安全事件，并构建一个仅缺少被归责原因的对照组进行对比实验。其核心解决方案在于：通过精确还原事故场景并设置控制变量，实现对代理行为的可重复性测试。实验表明，ROGUE-AI成功复现了89%的108次尝试事件；基于GPT、Claude、Gemini和DeepSeek等五种主流大模型的代理在存在特定缺陷时，错误发生率高达18%至33%，而缺失该缺陷的对照组错误率不超过1%。进一步分析发现，72起造成真实危害的事件中，62起无外部攻击者参与，问题根源在于代理正确执行任务但忽视了如生产数据库共享等常见风险。值得注意的是，在无攻击者场景下的复现造成的危害反而高于提示注入（prompt injection）类攻击，且现有防御机制针对注入指令设计，但在无注入的情况下失效。此外，每步工具输出后添加关于风险及其后果的警告，显著降低了所有模型的危害程度，而同等长度但未指明风险的说明则几乎无效。由此，ROGUE-AI构建的基于真实事件的可复现审计框架，为厂商在发布新版本前提供了一套可重复使用的安全验证机制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26553
作者: Mengxiao Wang,Mahbub Alam,Kalyan Nakka,Nitesh Saxena
机构: Texas A&M University (德州农工大学)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 21 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now delete files and send payments on behalf of their users. News media reports routinely describe failures of these agents (e.g., Replit’s coding agent deleting a production database), but a report often only says what went wrong and rarely (in)validates the incident or finds its root cause. Incident catalogs collect these reports, and benchmarks record whether agents fail, but neither replicates an incident nor tests the cause its report might identify. In this paper, we present ROGUE-AI (Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation), a multi-agent framework that closes the above gap and rebuilds each reported incident offline together with a matched control that lacks only the blamed cause, and runs agents on both. Our results suggest that ROGUE-AI is able to reproduce the reported harm in 89% of its 108 attempted replications. Agents built on five current GPT, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek models made the reported mistake in 18% to 33% of runs, against at most 1% without the blamed cause. Of the 72 incidents with real-world harm, 62 had no underlying attacker, and in these, agents did what their task asked for but missed an ordinary hazard, such as a database shared with the live site. Replications without an attacker caused more harm than replications of prompt injection for all five models. Defenses against prompt injection look for injected instructions, but these replications contain none. Further, a warning after each tool output that names the hazard and its consequence lowered harm for all five models, whereas a note of the same length that does not mention the hazard left most of the harm in place. Built from real incidents, the ROGUE-AI replications form a reusable audit framework that vendors can rerun before each new release.

[MA-1] Public-Private Cooperation in the Port of Rotterdam: An Agent -Based Toy Model of Cooperative Efforts Against Cocaine Trafficking

【速读】：该论文旨在解决鹿特丹港（Port of Rotterdam, PoR）毒品走私治理中公共与私人部门协同合作（Public-Private Cooperation, PPC）的复杂性问题，尤其关注信任、合作、竞争、压力、执法强度及参与者能力等关键因素之间的动态交互机制。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个结合代理模型（Agent-Based Model, ABM）与因果回路图（Causal Loop Diagram, CLD）的“玩具模型”（toy model），通过模拟不同初始条件下参数扰动对协同治理效能的影响，揭示系统内在的结构性惯性。研究发现，单一措施难以在五年时间尺度上实现持久成效，而协调推进信任建设、合作强化与适度压力，并降低监管执行摩擦的多参数综合策略，可使治理效能提升25%，显著优于仅增强合作的孤立策略（13%提升）。该模型强调治理效能的高度制度依赖性，涵盖制度、关系、行为与资源准备度四维维度，为港口安全治理提供了基于系统动力学的探索性假设。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26154
作者: Frederike Oetker,Charlotte Geertman
机构: 未知
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cocaine trafficking poses a persistent governance challenge in the Port of Rotterdam (PoR), requiring cooperation between public and private actors. This paper develops an Agent-Based toy Model (ABM) coupled with a Causal Loop Diagram (CLD) to explore interactions between trust, cooperation, competition, pressure, enforcement, and actor skills in public-private cooperation (PPC). Based on empirical data of PPC in the PoR, we explore responses to parameter shocks across different initial configurations. In this model, effectiveness of PPC is strongly state-dependent and measures institutional, relational, behavioral, and resource readiness. The toy model demonstrates that isolated, single-track measures yield limited long-term gains modelled over 5 years due to structural system inertia, whereas coordinated multi-parameter strategies produce substantial improvements. Specifically, combining trust-building, cooperation, and moderate pressure with reduced regulatory enforcement friction raises effectiveness by 25% from a baseline effectiveness, compared to just 13% for an isolated increase in cooperation. Acknowledging the exploratory nature of the model, these findings offer exploratory hypotheses on port security governance. Future work should validate the model against test cases and additional expert input.

[MA-2] Law at the Speed of AI: Critical Legal Infrastructure for the Machine Age: Autonomy Under Law Architecture (AULA)

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自主人工智能代理（autonomous AI agents）在组织内外大规模部署所引发的法律可识别性缺失问题，即现有法律基础设施无法有效识别、解释和规制由自主代理产生的行为，导致责任归属不清与权利分配失序。其核心挑战在于：尽管底层通信与认证协议（如模型上下文协议Model Context Protocol和Agent2Agent协议）日趋成熟，但这些技术进展并未带来法律层面的可追溯性与可问责性。当前运行时权限控制仅限制资源访问，而不界定代理行为的法律授权基础，从而形成“法律归因鸿沟”（legal attribution gap）。该论文提出“法律之下的自治架构”（Autonomy Under Law Architecture, AULA），通过将AI系统与数据资产注册为依托于特定法律主体的法律客体，并以密码学绑定的智能法律工具（smart legal instruments）进行治理，实现对代理行为的实时法律评估。每个智能法律工具可包含“法律上下文条款”，使现行立法、监管及司法判例在行为发生时具备实际法律效力，从而构建兼具技术可行性与法律可执行性的新型治理基础设施，确保人类与自主机器共同参与的法律、财产权利与经济体系可持续运行。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25985
作者: Natasha E Blycha,James Myint,Chen Feng,Dr Amani Soysa,Koshin Jama,Schellie-Jayne Price,Matthew Blycha
机构: 未知
类目: Computational Engineering, Finance, and Science (cs.CE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Emerging Technologies (cs.ET); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 203 pages, 13 Tables and 17 Figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The global deployment of autonomous AI agents within and across organisations exceeds the governance infrastructure available to constrain it. Agent communication and authentication protocols, principally the Model Context Protocol and the Agent2Agent Protocol, are maturing quickly, but maturity at the protocol layer does not produce legal legibility at the governance layer. Runtime enforcement written by the deploying organisation fixes the resources an AI agent can reach, not the authority under which it acts. Legal legibility is the capacity of a legal system to recognise, interpret and regulate activity by mapping it onto legal personhood, property, rights and liabilities. Existing (analogue) legal infrastructure cannot supply it for autonomous deployment. The resulting deficit is bidirectional. It concerns the attribution of liability when an AI agent causes harm, and the allocation of rights, including data and economic rights, generated by agentic activity and by the AI agent itself as a source of value and form of property. This paper characterises that deficit as the legal attribution gap, a material and unaddressed risk to economies, organisations and citizens that is magnified in cross-organisational multi-agent deployment. The paper describes the Autonomy Under Law Architecture (AULA), in which AI systems and data assets are registered as legal objects anchored to one or more identified legal persons, governed by cryptographically tethered smart legal instruments and evaluated at runtime. Each smart legal instrument can carry a legal context clause, through which the legislation, regulation and judicial decisions in force at the time of the act are given practical and legal effect in that evaluation. Infrastructure of this kind is a precondition for the continued function of any legal, property and economic system with both human and autonomous machine stakeholders.

[MA-3] Coherent belief and opinion propagation produces more echo chambers: corrected version

【速读】：该论文旨在解决社交网络中回音室（echo chamber）形成机制的问题，特别是探究在意见传播过程中同时传播信念（belief）对回音室演化的影响。传统意见动态模型仅关注意见更新过程，而本研究通过引入经典的信念融合操作，将信念与意见的传播相结合，并基于共享价值观维持信念与意见的一致性，从而构建更贴近现实的认知传播框架。其解决方案的关键在于：在现有意见动态模型基础上，显式建模信念与意见的协同演化机制，并设计基于同质性、隔离性和强化性的量化指标以识别回音室。仿真结果表明，在不同初始条件和个体容忍度下，即使采用更严格的检测标准，回音室仍会形成；更重要的是，当意见与信念相连接并保持一致性时，虽然信念层面的回音室数量增加，但每个回音室所涉及的参与者数量减少，揭示了信念传播对回音室结构的细微影响。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25879
作者: Hiro Kataoka,J{é}r{ô}me Euzenat(MOEX),Koji Hasebe
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: kataoka2026e

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The occurrence of echo chambers is a well-known phenomenon in social networks. Echo chambers are groups of agents satisfying three properties: homogeneity, i.e., sharing the same opinion, segregation, i.e., listening primarily to agents of the same group, and reinforcement, i.e., increasing opinion similarity over time. Opinion dynamics models have been used to explain how echo chambers occur through agents updating their opinions. However, social network users also exchange beliefs supporting their opinions. Here, we aim at identifying the effect of propagating beliefs together with opinions on the formation of echo chambers. For that purpose, we complement an existing opinion dynamics model with classical belief merge operations. Beliefs and opinions are also maintained coherent guided by values that agents share. We introduce measures, applying to either beliefs and opinions, to identify echo chambers based on the three properties. This model is used to simulate opinion and belief propagation with varying initial conditions and agent tolerance for different opinions/beliefs. Results confirm the occurrence of echo chambers observed in previous opinion dynamics studies in a different setting and with a stricter measure. They also demonstrate the occurrence of echo chambers with belief propagation. Finally, they show that connecting opinions to beliefs and maintaining their coherence increases the number of belief echo chambers, but that they involve a reduced number of agents.

[MA-4] Interlacing Committees with Edge-Expansion

【速读】：该论文旨在解决基于批准投票（approval-based）的委员会选择中，如何有效衡量和优化委员会质量的问题。现有研究采用“交错性”（interlacing）框架，通过委员会诱导出选民间的相似性图，并以图的连通性作为评价标准。然而，该框架所使用的连通性度量存在局限性。本文提出将边扩张性（edge-expansion）这一经典的图论指标作为优化目标，因其在刻画网络极化现象方面具有坚实的理论基础。作者从信息传播模型的角度为交错性框架提供了理论支撑，并系统比较了边扩张性与先前提出的连通性度量之间的差异，揭示了其在捕捉结构特性上的本质不同。此外，论文分析了最大化边扩张性的计算复杂性：即使在选民区间偏好（voter-interval preferences）下，该问题仍为计算困难；但当委员会规模固定时，问题可在多项式时间内求解，且在选民-候选人区间偏好情形下，算法对委员会规模的依赖性得到显著优化。因此，该研究的关键在于引入边扩张性作为更优的优化目标，并建立了其理论合理性与可计算性边界。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25852
作者: Gili Bielous,Reshef Meir
机构: Technion - Israel Institute of Technology(以色列理工学院)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Approval-based committee selection has recently been studied through the lens of \emphinterlacing, a framework for studying polarization in approval elections, in which committees induce a similarity graph over voters. The quality of committees is then evaluated through the connectivity of the resulting graph. We revisit the connectivity measures used in this framework and propose \emphedge-expansion, a classical graph-theoretic measure with well-established connections to polarization in networks, as the optimization objective. We provide a theoretical foundation for this proposal by relating interlacing to classical models of information diffusion and by comparing edge-expansion with previously proposed connectivity objectives, identifying qualitative differences in the structural properties they capture. Finally, we study the computational complexity of optimizing edge-expansion, showing that hardness persists even for voter-interval preferences, while the problem is polynomial-time solvable for every fixed committee size, with an improved dependence on the committee size for voter-candidate-interval preferences.

[MA-5] DS2Agent : Holistic Device Agents for Accelerated Embedded Board-Level Design

【速读】：该论文旨在解决嵌入式板级开发中因组件选型、接口配置、驱动编写及系统集成等复杂任务所需高度专业知识而导致的效率瓶颈问题，尤其针对现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在板级设计场景下存在的局限性：既往方法或局限于芯片级设计，或将数据手册（datasheet）视为静态文本，缺乏对特定组件是否适用于目标板级设计的动态判断能力，且由于未与真实硬件交互，易产生幻觉性错误信息。其核心解决方案是提出一个开源框架DS2Agent，通过从设备数据手册构建可交互的智能体，该智能体由三个协同模型组成：知识模型用于支持知识检索与问答；数字孪生模型（digital-twin model）捕捉设备的物理功能行为；接口模型支持驱动开发与系统集成。为抑制幻觉，系统还支持可选的真实硬件连接，使智能体能够基于实际设备反馈校准其内部知识。实验表明，相较于基线方法，DS2Agent显著提升了问答准确率（87→97/100），并分别在驱动生成和系统集成任务中减少44.8%、72.9%和29.7%的平均令牌使用量，验证了其高效性与可靠性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25774
作者: Hongbin Yang,Chi Zhang,Yinhao Xiao,Runyu Pan,Yanni Yang,Xiuzhen Cheng
机构: Shandong University (山东大学); GDUFE-UCM Joint Institute, Guangdong University of Finance and Economics (广东财经大学-西班牙马德里康普顿斯大学联合学院)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Embedded board-level development demands extensive expertise, from component selection and device characteristics to interface configuration, driver writing, and system composition. Recently, LLM-based agents have shown strong capabilities, raising the prospect of automating board-level design tasks. However, existing agents either target chip-level design or treat datasheets as static text, offering little guidance on whether a specific component should—or even could—be used for a given board-level design. Moreover, without touching real hardware, they hallucinate incorrect details. To fill this gap, we present \setlength\fboxsep1pt\hrefthis https URL\fcolorboxbluewhiteDS2Agent, an open-source framework that constructs interactive agents from device datasheets. Each agent comprises three models: a knowledge model supporting retrieval and question answering; a digital-twin model capturing the physical functionality of the device; and an interface model supporting driver development and system integration. To suppress hallucinations, we also allow optional connections to real devices, so that the agent can calibrate its internalized knowledge against the device. We evaluate DS2Agent on ten devices spanning seven functional categories. Compared with the baseline, the DS2Agent-augmented agent improves the question-answering score from 87 to 97 out of 100 while using 44.8% fewer tokens. For driver generation, it reduces average token usage per device by 72.9%. For system integration, it reduces total token usage across three FreeRTOS applications by 29.7%. [MA-6] GRODE-RTL: Source-Mapped Dependency Views for LLM -Based RTL Repair

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在自动修复寄存器传输级（Register-Transfer Level, RTL）设计中非局部故障（non-local faults）时所面临的挑战，即根因与故障输出在源代码中相距甚远，导致传统将RTL视为扁平令牌序列的方法难以捕捉硬件数据流的拓扑结构。现有方法或因过度简化而丢失关键依赖关系，或因暴露完整综合网表而导致模型被细粒度元数据淹没。为此，论文提出GRODE-RTL——一种以锚点为中心的表示方法，其核心在于从网表中提取可疑寄存器的单时钟周期扇入锥（fan-in cone），将网表节点映射回可编辑的源代码行，并构建紧凑的跳段划分（hop-partitioned）依赖视图。该方法通过优先保留直接驱动信号并折叠远距离跳转，有效引导标准工具使用型智能体进行修复，同时避免引入真实答案提示或Oracle反馈。实验在30个经形式化验证的非局部故障上评估了三种大语言模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2和MiniMax-M3），结合六组配置的消融研究，结果表明：相较于源码级探索，GRODE-RTL使pass@1分别提升16.7%（DeepSeek）、26.7%（GLM-5.2）和20.0%（MiniMax-M3），且在所有模型中对远距离和间接锚点子集均保持一致增益。控制实验进一步证明，选择性依赖组织而非全图暴露才是实现高效RTL修复的关键。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.25661
作者: Jingyi Zhou,Yi Liu,Bin Sun,Hongji Zhang,Dongsheng Zuo,Qiang Xu
机构: The Chinese University of Hong Kong(香港中文大学); Institute of Computing Technology, CAS(中国科学院计算技术研究所)
类目: Hardware Architecture (cs.AR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large Language Models show great potential for automated Register-Transfer Level repair, yet they struggle with non-local faults where root causes and failing outputs reside far apart in source code. Treating RTL as a flat token sequence obscures hardware dataflows, whereas exposing complete synthesized graphs overwhelms the model with fine-grained metadata. To resolve this representation dilemma, we propose GRODE-RTL, an anchor-centric representation that extracts the single-clock-stage fan-in cone of a suspect register from the netlist, maps netlist nodes back to editable source lines, and organizes them into a compact hop-partitioned dependency view. By prioritizing direct drivers and folding distant hops, GRODE-RTL guides standard tool-using agents without exposing ground-truth hints or oracle feedback. We evaluate GRODE-RTL across 30 formally validated non-local faults using three LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3) alongside a controlled six-configuration ablation study. GRODE-RTL improves pass@1 over source-level exploration by 16.7% on DeepSeek, by 26.7% on GLM-5.2, and by 20.0% on MiniMax-M3, with consistent gains on the hard-to-retrieve far-distance and indirect-anchor subsets of all three models. Our controls isolate structural relevance from generic context expansion, proving that selective dependency organization rather than full graph exposure is key to effective RTL repair.

[MA-7] Game-Theoretic Data Allocation for Expert Specialization and Routing

【速读】：该论文旨在解决如何在不依赖显式训练门控机制的情况下，预测并实现最优专家选择的问题。核心挑战在于：能否通过训练前的专家分配（allocation）预先判断哪个专家在特定提示（prompt）上表现最佳，从而实现推理阶段的可解释性分工与高效路由。其解决方案的关键在于提出InflEns框架——一种基于固定提示-特质空间中位置博弈（location game）的LoRA专家混合模型，其中专家的训练权重与推理路由均源自同一博弈过程。该博弈以最大化各专家对提示分布的预期份额为目标，不依赖专家损失函数。通过引入博弈核的通用理论判据，可判断共位专家位置是否因局部不稳定而发生分离，从而实现自然的专业化分工。实验表明，在七个安全相关基准构建的语料上，采用锐化单纯形表示时，最高份额专家在约90%的提示上具有最低的保留响应负对数似然（NLL），远优于随机置换分配后的15%；且无需训练显式门控网络即可达到与已有学习门控相当的性能。由于路由器固定，可精准定位有害行为来源，仅需重训单一专家，使HarmBench攻击成功率从0.51降至0.02，同时保持指令遵循能力。此外，该框架可通过核函数选择、特质空间几何结构及专家数量等参数灵活调控专业化程度，具备高度通用性，适用于任意编码器与数据分布。

Abstract:Can the allocation used to train experts also predict which expert will perform best on a prompt? Such a connection would make the intended division of labor inspectable before training and allow the allocation itself to guide inference. We introduce InflEns, a mixture of LoRA experts whose training weights and inference routes come from the same location game in a fixed prompt-trait space. Players choose positions to maximize their expected shares of the prompt distribution, without using expert losses. We utilize the game’s kernel-general theoretical criterion for when co-located positions become locally unstable to separation. We evaluate InflEns on a corpus assembled from seven safety-related benchmarks, which demonstrates that the highest-share expert has the lowest held-out response negative log-likelihood (NLL) on approximately 90% of prompts across four kernels under a sharpened simplex representation, compared with approximately 15% after permuting allocations across prompts. We demonstrate that the method performs comparably to published learned gates without having to train an explicit gate on the experts. Because the router is fixed, we can trace harmful behavior to a single expert and retrain only that expert, which lowers HarmBench attack success from 0.51 to 0.02 while keeping instruction following. The game also gives us several controls over how the experts specialize, including the kernel choice and its parameters, the trait-space geometry, and the number of experts. Importantly, InflEns is a general framework that can be extended to any encoder and data distribution.

[MA-8] GridAnchor: Specialized Multi-Agent AI for Safeguarding Autonomous Energy Systems Against Cyber-Physical Hallucinations

【速读】：该论文旨在解决自主能源系统中由多个专业化学习代理（如预测器、状态估计器和调度器）协同工作时产生的“网络物理幻觉”（cyber-physical hallucinations）问题，即代理输出虽具高置信度但违背物理规律，进而引发下游代理的错误决策与连锁反应。其核心解决方案是提出一种名为GridAnchor的验证层，关键在于采用基于物理残差的图变换器（Physics-Residual Graph Transformer），通过计算代理输出、测量值与线性化电网模型之间的残差，对每个声明进行评分；结合Mondrian conformal p-values与Benjamini-Hochberg校正程序将评分转化为可解释的决策，实现对幻觉及其传播路径的根因定位；并通过一个二次规划优化器，在修复步骤中以电压裕度为约束条件纠正不安全操作。实验表明，该方法在模拟农村中压馈线上达到0.846的消息级精确率-召回率曲线下面积，优于六种基线模型，且误报率保持在名义水平附近，闭环运行下无节点电压越限，显著提升了系统的物理一致性与安全性。

Abstract:Autonomous energy systems increasingly chain specialized learned agents, such as a forecaster, a state estimator and a dispatcher that may be a language model. These agents can emit confident outputs that contradict physics, and downstream agents may act on them. We define such cyber-physical hallucinations and their cascades, organize them in eight types, and build CPH-Bench, a generator of labeled episodes on SimBench feeders. We propose GridAnchor, a verification layer whose Physics-Residual Graph Transformer scores every claim from residuals between the claims, the measurements and a linearized grid model. Mondrian conformal p-values with the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure turn the scores into decisions, a root head attributes cascades, and a quadratic program repairs unsafe actions with a voltage margin calibrated at repaired steps. On a simulated rural medium-voltage feeder, GridAnchor reaches a message-level area under the precision-recall curve of 0.846, against 0.837 for the strongest of six baselines, a difference within the confidence interval. It leads on estimates and actions, whereas a self-consistency check that knows the label tolerances reaches 0.874 by leading on forecasts. The false-alarm rate stays within 0.17 percentage points of the nominal level on steps without injected hallucinations. In closed loop, GridAnchor leaves no bus outside the voltage band on the test days, against 0.0700% of the bus-steps without protection, and simpler detectors with the same mitigation come close. Stale but coherent messages and single-bus forecast errors remain mostly undetected.

[MA-9] BuggyMLE: Scaling Machine Learning Engineering Difficulty with Bug Injection

【速读】：该论文旨在解决当前机器学习工程（Machine Learning Engineering, MLE）基准测试中代理（agent）能力评估受限的问题，即现有基准普遍局限于单文件编辑且缺乏对完整代码仓库及终端环境的访问权限，难以真实反映复杂模型开发中的多文件协作、依赖管理、调试与框架迁移等实际挑战。其核心解决方案在于提出一种名为“代码复杂度指数”（Code Complexity Index, CCI）的新度量标准，基于仓库规模、依赖深度和补丁大小等十个结构化特征，能够有效预测多个公开编码基准上的平均求解率（R² = 0.951），并识别出补丁大小与复杂度为关键预测因子。基于CCI，研究构建了可扩展的BuggyMLE框架，通过在222个真实ML仓库中注入可控缺陷，生成超过6,600个带缺陷的MLE仓库变体及近26万行注入代码。在此基础上，研究首次构建了难度分级的仓库级MLE基准——BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite，验证结果显示，随着难度从最低到最高层级提升，模型最高求解率由95%降至9%；同时，利用三层次难度的训练课程对Qwen3.5-9B模型进行微调，使其在BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite上表现媲美前沿模型，并展现出良好的跨领域迁移能力：在SWE-bench Lite上的解决率从24%提升至33%，在LiveCodeBench v6上的pass@1指标从69%提升至71%。

Abstract:Enabling AI systems to autonomously improve AI models requires agents capable of performing machine learning engineering (MLE). In practice, designing, training, and evaluating complex models demands modifying multi-file repositories to reproduce results, debug training runs, integrate datasets, and port frameworks. However, existing MLE benchmarks limit agents to single-file edits without full repository or shell access, and common repository-level software engineering benchmarks have rapidly saturated. To address this, we introduce the Code Complexity Index (CCI), a difficulty metric based on ten structural features spanning repository scale, dependency depth, and patch size. CCI strongly predicts average solve rates across eight public coding benchmarks ( R^2 = 0.951 ), identifying patch size and complexity as top predictors. Guided by CCI, we develop BuggyMLE, a scalable framework where agents inject controlled mutations into working ML repositories, synthesizing over 6,600 bug-injected MLE repository variants and nearly 260K lines of injected code based on 222 source repositories. Using BuggyMLE, we make two contributions. First, we construct BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite, the first difficulty-graded, repository-level variant of MLE-Bench Lite; across 14 evaluated models, the top solve rate drops from 95% to 9% as difficulty is scaled from the easiest to the hardest tier. Second, we synthesize a training curriculum across three difficulty levels over 200 additional ML repositories, fine-tuning a Qwen3.5-9B model to rival frontier models on BuggyMLE-Bench-Lite. Our trained model transfers beyond ML, raising its SWE-bench Lite resolve rate from 24% to 33% and its LiveCodeBench v6 pass@1 from 69% to 71%.

[MA-10] FinVeriQA: Financial Research Agents for Question Answering: Routing Retrieval MCP Tool Use and Provenance-Aware Evidence Verification STOC

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在金融问答任务中普遍存在但关键的可靠性问题：尽管其生成文本流畅，却常出现财务比率计算错误、引用过时股价以及错误调用工具等严重失误，且往往以高置信度输出。核心挑战在于如何在多智能体系统中合理分配各组件职责，以实现准确、可验证的金融分析。解决方案的关键在于构建一个分层、分工明确的协同架构——通过一个轻量级的类型化决策模型（Laya）负责任务路由与意图识别，避免将复杂计算或证据检索交由通用语言模型处理；由专用的Python环境执行所有数值计算，确保精确性；利用检索与外部工具获取实时证据；由Mistral-7B生成带引用的答案；并通过代码验证器独立核验引用编号是否存在及数值是否一致，同时引入模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）服务器统一管理整个流水线。实验表明，该架构显著提升了任务路由准确性（Laya达0.85，优于Mistral-7B的0.52），使财务计算正确率从29%提升至100%，并将股价误差从210%降至0.00%。然而，研究也揭示了共享证据污染下的自洽性陷阱：当共同证据被篡改时，模型仍保持高一致性（0.55–0.59），但准确率骤降至0，凸显验证必须独立于原始证据来源的重要性——仅依赖共享证据检查可捕获35%错误，而直接比对原文可捕获77%以上（p = 5.96×10⁻⁸），证明独立验证机制是保障可信输出的核心。

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) write fluent financial analyses but miscompute ratios, recall stale prices, and route questions to the wrong tool with high confidence. We ask which component should do each job in a financial question-answering assistant, and study it with FinVeriQA, an open-source multi-agent research prototype over SEC filings and live market data: a compact typed-decision model (Laya) routes each question and screens out advice requests, Python computes every number, retrieval and tools fetch evidence, Mistral-7B writes a cited answer, a code validator checks that cited IDs exist and that numbers match computed notes, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposes the pipeline. In live experiments, Laya routed better than Mistral-7B (0.85 vs. 0.52; overall 0.86 vs. 0.68, McNemar p = 0.0003); a 12B Mistral decided no better, and DeepSeek-R1-8B decided better (0.79 vs. 0.68, p = 0.0192) but about 9.9 times more slowly. Mistral-7B computed 29% of 100 financial calculations correctly against 100% for Python, a live quote cut price error from 210% to 0.00%, and hybrid retrieval reached 76% Hit@5 on 50 filing questions. Yet in a live case study, both agent answers passed validation while describing AMD sample data under NVIDIA’s and Alphabet’s names. A controlled upper-bound study on the FinRank benchmark explains why: when one figure in the shared evidence is corrupted, self-consistency stays confident (agreement 0.55 to 0.59 while accuracy falls from 0.50 to 0.00), and a shared-evidence check (the kind our validator performs) catches 35% of the errors, whereas a check against the original passage catches 77% ( p = 5.96 \times 10^-8 ); for DeepSeek-R1-8B, 68% vs. 90%. Verification must be independent of the evidence the writer saw.

[MA-11] Attacks and Defenses in Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems with Hop-by-Hop Task Decomposition and Delegation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决去中心化多智能体大语言模型（Decentralized Multi-Agent LLM）系统中因缺乏全局监管而引发的安全挑战，特别是恶意智能体对任务完整性、可用性与机密性的威胁。其核心问题在于：在无中心协调的环境下，各智能体独立运行且彼此不可信，导致无法有效验证行为合法性，进而可能引发任务失败、资源滥用及敏感信息泄露。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于密码学的协议，能够生成不可抵赖的可验证执行追溯链（verified execution trace），确保每个操作行为均可被审计与溯源；同时设计一个审计器（auditor）对这些追溯链进行分析，实现对恶意行为的高精度检测与归因。实验结果表明，该方案在隐藏基准测试（HiddenBench）上对gpt-6.1-sol和Qwen3.8-27B-FP8模型均表现出极低延迟开销，并成功识别并正确归因98%的攻击行为，包括那些表面合规但实际恶意的攻击。

Abstract:Decentralized multi-agent LLM systems enable independently administered agents, each with its own operator, model, memory, and configuration, to collaborate on complex tasks without centralized coordination. Agents autonomously decompose tasks, execute subtasks and delegate remaining work to peers, enabling scalability and eliminating single points of failure. However, decentralization also introduces significant security challenges, as no single entity has complete visibility into task execution or the authority to enforce correct behavior across agents. In this paper, we systematize threats from malicious agents in decentralized multi-agent systems and propose mitigation techniques. We first design and evaluate attacks against integrity, availability, and confidentiality, demonstrating that a single malicious agent can cause up to 100% task failure, inflate token consumption and runtime by up to 7.7x and 3.2x, respectively, and exfiltrate up to 94% of relevant prior tasks from benign agents. We then present a cryptographic protocol that produces an irrefutable verified execution trace of every action taken in the system and develop an auditor that analyzes these traces to detect and attribute malicious behavior. Evaluations on HiddenBench using gpt-6.1-sol and Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 show that our protocol incurs negligible latency overhead, while the auditor detects and correctly attributes 98% of attacks, including those that comply with the protocol. Abstract:With k\geq 1 repairpersons starting initially from a depot, we present a 3.877-competitive deterministic algorithm for the fundamental online traveling repairperson problem on an arbitrary metric. For the special class of zero-residual instances, we improve the ratio to 3+\epsilon for every \epsilon0 . We also extend these results to some variants of the related so-called online dial-a-ride problem. The state-of-the-art is the 4-competitive deterministic algorithm for both problems.

[MA-13] Evolving Decoding Algorithms for Quantum Error Correction NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决量子纠错中如何高效实现容错性的问题，具体而言是针对量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码在连续测量噪声量子态时，如何通过经典解码算法快速、可靠地推断并纠正噪声。其核心挑战在于在保持高纠错性能的同时，显著提升解码速度以满足实时性需求。解决方案的关键在于构建一个领域特定语言（DSL），将已发表的信念传播（BP）类解码器形式化表达，并利用语法演化（grammatical evolution）对解码器参数进行自动搜索与优化。通过在DSL中显式呈现解码器参数，研究者可预先对BP+OSD与BP+LSD解码器引入阻尼（damping）机制，从而实现17.1至41.0倍的速度提升及更高的错误容忍率；更优的是，演化出的新型解码器在更低的时间开销下显著优于传统调优解码器，其中最快版本在仅需原方法1/31时间的情况下仍实现更高精度，且在不同噪声水平、码长和轮次下具有良好的泛化能力。这表明，将专家经验编码于DSL中形成的人机协同优化中间层，有效融合了人类直觉与机器学习的优化能力，为实现高效量子纠错提供了新范式。

作者: Eduardo Dueñez,Edgar Said Hernandez Sanchez,Edgar A. Duéñez-Guzmán,Suzanne Sadedin

类目: Quantum Physics (quant-ph); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Neural and Evolutionary Computing (cs.NE)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Quantum computation entails robustness engineering: a noisy quantum state is measured continuously, and a classical algorithm (the decoder) must infer corrections that reliably remove the noise, fast enough to keep up. We write several published belief-propagation (BP) decoders for quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes in a Domain-Specific Language (DSL), and search over it with grammatical evolution. Written in the language, the published decoders show their parameters in plain view, allowing us to re-parameterise BP+OSD (ordered statistics decoding) and BP+LSD (localized statistics decoding) decoders with damping, before any search, making each 17.1–41.0 \times faster at a higher error rate, and BP+OSD-0 about 103 faster than the ldpc package’s version tuned on the [[72,12,6]] bivariate-bicycle code. Evolution over the language finds decoders that improve the time-error front. One makes 23% fewer logical errors than BP+OSD-0 with damping at 0.64 \times its time, and decoders evolved from random code are more accurate than ldpc’s tuned BP+OSD-0 at 1/31 of its time or less. Frozen at one operating point, the two fastest evolved decoders generalize well across noise levels, code sizes and round counts, staying at the time-error front. Ultimately, we demonstrate that capturing expert knowledge within a DSL creates a powerful intermediate layer—one that effectively bridges human intuition and machine-driven optimization to unlock highly efficient quantum error correction.

自然语言处理

[NLP-0] Agent RoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前前沿多模态语言代理在直接机器人控制任务中缺乏细粒度行为分析的问题。现有评估基准仅提供任务级别的成功率，无法揭示代理在执行过程中的具体成功机制或失败原因，导致对模型能力与局限性的理解过于粗略。为此，论文提出一种关键解决方案——AgentRoboCritic，这是一个基于意图的批判框架：在每一步动作执行时，策略代理（policy agent）同时声明其局部意图（local intent），由一个独立的批评者（critic）根据该意图评估动作结果及失败模式。该方法实现了动作级（action-level）的系统性分析，能够精准识别代理在闭环恢复、语义一致性以及零样本操作等方面的能力，同时揭示其在抓取、对齐等物理执行瓶颈上的局限性及不同失败模式间恢复能力的不均衡性。研究通过在400条人工标注动作的基准上验证该批评框架，并发布包含12,844条标注动作的数据集，配合微调后的开源批评模型Muse-Glimmer-30B，将失败模式识别准确率从32.58%提升至74.24%，显著降低了动作级分析的成本，为理解与改进生成式机器人控制提供了可扩展、可解释的新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26613
作者: Yiyang Du,Yuxuan Kuang,Qitao Zhao,Yixuan Wang,Zhanqiu Guo,Yi Xu,Xin Li,Wenbin He,Liu Ren,Chenyan Xiong
机构: Carnegie Mellon University (卡内基梅隆大学); University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (伊利诺伊大学香槟分校); Bosch Research North America (博世北美研究中心); Bosch Center for Artificial Intelligence (BCAI) (博世人工智能中心)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: 28 pages. Project page: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action’s outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

[NLP-1] Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决后训练（post-training）是否改变语言模型内部表征（representation）及其输出判断方式的核心问题。研究发现，后训练并未显著改变模型对输入内容的内在表征能力，但显著改变了判断结果的读出机制（readout）。其关键在于：后训练通过调整模型在决策过程中的敏感度（sensitivity）与先验信念（base rate）的使用方式，改变了模型输出答案的逻辑方向。具体表现为，后训练使模型在人类/机器文本判别任务中平均敏感度下降（Δd’ = -0.34），且更倾向于过度响应先验概率；而在否定陈述真实性判断任务中，后训练反而修复了基线模型对真实性的误判，使答案性能提升至接近理论上限，并且这种修复效应集中在模型中层及深层的上下文位置之后的状态中。此外，实验表明仅需少量标注数据即可引导后训练的方向性转变，说明读出机制的调整具有高度可塑性。因此，该研究揭示了后训练主要影响的是“如何从已有表征中读出答案”，而非“表征本身”的本质变化。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26584
作者: Jochen Laubrock
机构: University of Potsdam (波茨坦大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 64 pages, 7+2 figures, 4+6 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Does post-training change what a language model represents, or how this representation is read out into an answer? We compared linear probes with the models’ own answers, analyzed with signal detection theory, in six open-weight base models and their post-trained versions. For judgments of whether German texts were written by a human or an AI, probes and word n-gram classifiers separated the classes well, but the answers did not and often ordered the texts inversely. Post-training lowered the sensitivity of the answers on average ( \Delta d’ = -0.34 across model families; -0.29 across three prompts). It also changed the use of a stated base rate: Base models shifted their log-odds by less than the stated change in prior odds, most post-trained models by more. In two models with stage-wise checkpoints, the change occurred during supervised fine-tuning, model stitching implicated the early layers, and from mid-depth on internal states at positions after the text, not those of the text, transferred the change between checkpoints. Our corpora cannot be shared, so we add a case reproducible from public data, the truth of negated statements. Here, post-training acted in the opposite direction: Probes decoded truth at or near ceiling in every model, the answers of several base models did not use it, and post-training repaired them; by mid-depth the repair resided at the positions after the statement; below it, the representation of the statement contributed, strongly in one of four models. In a training study, adding 2,000 correctly labeled authorship judgments of news texts to otherwise identical fine-tuning data improved the answers on our newspaper and textbook corpora and inverted them on the chats, where they followed a news-trained probe of the base model. Post-training thus changed how a judgment is read out of what a model represents, and a small training signal can set its direction.

[NLP-2] Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决印度马哈拉施特拉邦政府政策与公共服务信息检索中，公民信息需求与正式行政描述之间因语言差异及术语不一致导致的匹配难题。其核心挑战在于跨语言（英语-马拉地语）环境下如何实现精准、高效的语义检索。解决方案的关键在于构建一个双语检索系统，通过等权重融合机制结合传统的词项匹配方法（BM25）与基于句子嵌入的语义相似性计算（如IndicSBERT和MahaSBERT），在统一索引中对齐英-马拉地语政策描述进行多语言、马拉地语主导及翻译中介的语义配置。实验表明，混合检索显著优于纯密集检索（dense retrieval），在平均倒数排名（MRR）上分别提升至0.872（IndicSBERT）和0.879（MahaSBERT），同时在精度（Precision）上从0.781提升至0.808，且保持与BM25相当的召回率（Recall=0.946）。结果验证了在该语料中词法信号与语义信号具有互补性，但相较于强大的词法基线，性能提升幅度有限且依赖具体评估指标，凸显了混合检索在实际政务信息访问场景中的有效性与应用价值。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26514
作者: Aishwarya Gunjal,Kanchan Khemnar,Pawan Poojary,Pranav Kulkarni,Raviraj Joshi,Manish Khodaskar
机构: Pune Institute of Computer Technology, Pune, India(普奈计算机技术学院, 普奈, 印度); L3Cube Labs, Pune, India( L3Cube 实验室, 普奈, 印度)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Retrieving government schemes requires matching citizens’ information needs to formal administrative descriptions, often across languages and terminology. We present a bilingual search system for Maharashtra government schemes and public services that combines BM25 retrieval with sentence-embedding similarity through equal-weight score fusion. The system indexes aligned English-Marathi scheme descriptions and supports multilingual, Marathi-focused, and translation-mediated semantic configurations. Evaluation on manually curated bilingual queries compares BM25, dense retrieval, and hybrid retrieval using IndicSBERT and MahaSBERT. BM25 provides a strong baseline with a mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 0.864. Hybrid retrieval increases MRR to 0.872 with IndicSBERT and 0.879 with MahaSBERT, whereas the corresponding dense-only systems achieve 0.663 and 0.655. MahaSBERT-based fusion also increases precision from 0.781 to 0.808 while matching BM25 recall at 0.946. These results support the complementary use of lexical and semantic signals in this collection, while showing that improvements over a strong lexical baseline are modest and metric-dependent. The study provides an application-focused analysis of hybrid retrieval for bilingual public-service information access.

[NLP-3] AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决后训练阶段（post-training）中仅依赖任务成功指标无法有效引导行为强化的问题，尤其针对教师模型（teacher model）生成的轨迹中存在的不良习惯、无效重复或表面验证等隐性缺陷。其核心解决方案是提出一种基于技能引导的微调方法——Skill-FT（Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning），通过自然语言形式的技能指令，在教师模型的推理过程中抑制不良行为并激发被忽视的有效行为。关键创新在于构建了名为AutoMaster的自主后训练系统，该系统由大语言模型（LLM）代理驱动，能够自动完成轨迹分析、技能设计、数据筛选及基于回放与目标模型评估的反馈迭代，实现闭环优化。实验结果表明，在终端操作、搜索和软件工程任务中，使用4B和9B规模的目标模型时，AutoMaster相较于传统的无引导监督微调（Vanilla SFT）在成功轨迹上的平均性能提升了1.42至8.99个百分点。此外，研究发现保留技能指令进行微调虽在评估阶段不参与推理，但能显著提升模型平均表现，表明在训练示范中保留技能上下文有助于更深层次的行为内化。这说明行为塑造（behavioral shaping）可有效提升固定模型作为教师的指导效能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26510
作者: Guoxin Chen,Shuang Sun,Fanzhe Meng,Xinyu Tang,Ruihua Song,Wayne Xin Zhao
机构: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China(中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Website: this https URL Code: this https URL Models: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.

[NLP-4] GLiDE: A Fast Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式推理（generative reasoning）虽能显著提升决策质量，但其高昂的计算成本（如逐词生成、长序列推理）限制了在实时、低延迟场景下的应用问题。核心挑战在于如何在保持单次前向传播（single forward pass）的高效性的同时，有效迁移推理过程带来的性能增益。其解决方案的关键在于提出GLiDE系列决策模型，通过移除全注意力层中的因果掩码（causal masking），实现上下文、问题与候选答案之间的双向交互，从而增强模型对复杂语义关系的理解能力；同时，采用多教师软目标蒸馏（soft-target distillation）结合渐进式后训练（progressive post-training），将多个推理模型的知识迁移至轻量级决策框架中；此外，引入无参数递归深度（parameter-free recurrent depth）机制，在不生成新文本的前提下增加推理时的计算深度，进一步提升决策准确性。实验表明，所有规模的GLiDE模型均位于Hugging Face DI基准的性能-参数帕累托前沿，其中27B版本在单卡上实现73.37的隐集得分（hidden-set score）、2.1%的期望校准误差及92.9毫秒中位延迟，显著优于同规模或更小模型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26509
作者: Sahibzada Allahyar,Julia White,Dhruv Atreja,George Hurn-Maloney,Urchade Zaratiana
机构: Fastino Labs
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 18 pages, 8 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Decision models enable fast, confidence-aware decisions by scoring candidate answers in a single forward pass, without generating text or intermediate reasoning. Yet reasoning can substantially improve decision quality, raising the question of whether its benefits can be retained without the cost of generating it. We investigate this question with \textbfGLiDE, a family of decision models spanning 0.4B to 27B parameters. Building on Qwen hybrid language models, GLiDE enables bidirectional interactions between the context, question, and candidate answers by removing causal masking from full-attention layers. To transfer reasoning capabilities into single-pass inference, we combine soft-target distillation from multiple teachers, including a reasoning model, with progressive post-training on diverse decision tasks. We further explore parameter-free recurrent depth to increase inference-time computation without generating tokens. Across five model sizes, GLiDE lies on the performance–parameter Pareto frontier of the Hugging Face \DI, with each model outperforming evaluated alternatives of equal or smaller size. \dmtwo (27B) achieves a hidden-set score of 71.52, with an expected calibration error of 2.0% and a median latency of 92.9,ms on a single GPU. Further checkpoint averaging and parameter-free recurrent depth yield GLiDE~27B, which reaches 73.37 with an expected calibration error of 2.1%. [NLP-5] Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决放射科胸片报告与影像学证据之间潜在不一致性的自动检测问题，即在缺乏人工干预的情况下，如何准确识别报告描述与图像分析结果之间的矛盾。其核心解决方案是构建一个基于生成式AI（Generative AI）的智能校验系统——Rad-Linter，该系统结合预训练的图像分类器提供的九种病理学得分与经过LoRA微调的15亿参数语言模型，对报告内容与图像评分的一致性进行判断。关键创新在于利用微调后的语言模型理解报告中病灶描述的语义细节，从而超越传统关键词与否定规则基线在复杂表述上的局限性。实验采用受控的报告-评分配对（来自OpenI数据集），通过反事实四元组设计确保每份报告和评分向量同时出现在一致与不一致条件下，使仅依赖单一输入的基线模型准确率上限为50%。结果显示，在131个四元组上，Rad-Linter达到98.5%的配对准确率，显著优于规则基线的80.5%，且在正确分类全部四对组合方面表现更优（94.4% vs. 56.5%）。尤其在需语义理解的发现描述类型上，差距更为明显；而未经微调的语言模型性能仍接近随机水平（约50%），凸显微调对任务成功的关键作用。在包含标注分歧的第二组181个四元组中，该系统仍保持93.4%的准确率，高于规则基线的75.3%，进一步验证了其在真实复杂场景下的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26492
作者: Yanda Cheng,Bo Wen,Yuhao Lu
机构: Cornell University (康奈尔大学); University of Rochester (罗切斯特大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 34 pages, 4 figures, including supplementary material

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review. A pretrained image classifier supplies scores for nine pathologies, and a 1.5B-parameter language model, fine-tuned with LoRA on 1,816 examples, checks their consistency with the report. We compare it with a keyword-and-negation rule baseline given the same reports and scores. Evaluation uses controlled report-score pairings from OpenI, with consistency labels derived from automatic report labels and score thresholds. Each counterfactual quad crosses two real reports with two real score vectors from other patients, creating two consistent and two inconsistent pairs. Every report and score vector occurs in both conditions, so either input alone permits only 50% accuracy. On 131 quads, Rad-Linter achieves 98.5% pair accuracy versus 80.5% for the rule baseline, and classifies all four pairs correctly in 94.4% of quads versus 56.5%. The checkers perform similarly on omission items, including unmentioned and negated findings; larger differences occur on the remaining item types, which require interpreting how findings are described. The same language model without fine-tuning remains near 50% accuracy. On a second set of 181 quads that also includes reports on which the automatic labelers disagree, pair accuracy is 93.4% versus 75.3%. These controlled results show that, given the same image-derived scores, a trained language model detects report-score inconsistencies more accurately than the tested rule baseline, with the advantage concentrated in interpreting how findings are worded.

[NLP-6] MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长期智能体（long-term agents）在持续交互过程中积累海量外部记忆（external memory）所引发的存储、检索与响应生成效率下降的问题。核心挑战在于：记忆条目数量增长导致检索开销上升，而较长的检索上下文又加剧预填充计算与解码阶段的注意力开销，二者相互耦合，形成性能瓶颈。现有方法通过剪枝或合并记录来压缩记忆，但前者可能丢失有效证据，后者则可能导致合并后的单元过长，难以高效处理。为此，本文提出一种结构引导的记忆折叠框架 MemFolder，其关键在于通过共享的记忆分组（memory groups）实现双重优化：一方面利用跨记录的结构信息指导证据合并，另一方面生成紧凑表示并借助验证反馈进行自修正。具体而言，RecordFolder 基于实体提及识别，逐步选择具有代表性和互补性的锚点，并结合语义与实体亲和性及时间链式关系，将兼容记录合并为更少的检索单元；ContextFolder 则在这些分组内对原始记录进行紧凑编码，并通过关键事实恢复失败反馈动态修正编码内容。实验在三个文本型记忆基准（LoCoMo、PersonaMem、LongMemEval）和两个多模态基准（M3-Bench-web、M3-Bench-robot）上验证了该方法的有效性。结果显示，在 Mem0 测试集上，RecordFolder 在仅保留 50% 记忆条目的情况下仍维持 99.0% 的平均性能，且相比最强基线提升 1.9 个百分点；结合 ContextFolder 后，现有压缩方法可进一步缩短输出长度并保持高性能保留，显著提升了记忆系统的整体效率与可扩展性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26427
作者: Xuyang Liu,Chenwen Lu,Junxi Wang,Siyu Ren,Xinying Lin,Siteng Huang,Hongli Sun,Linfeng Zhang,Honggang Chen
机构: Sichuan University(四川大学); Fudan University(复旦大学); Sun Yat-sen University(中山大学); Zhejiang University(浙江大学); Shanghai Jiao Tong University(上海交通大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注: Code is available at this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.

[NLP-7] HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）中注意力机制计算效率低下的问题，特别是全量点积（full dot product）带来的高昂计算开销。现有大多数稀疏注意力方法通过在序列长度维度（token sparsity）上减少注意力计算，而本文提出一种新型的隐藏稀疏注意力（Hidden Sparse Attention, HiSA），其核心创新在于在隐藏（特征）维度实现稀疏性——即在不改变查询（query）和键（key）投影结构的前提下，依据位置信息采用静态、无参数的规则仅计算部分点积。该方法基于旋转位置编码（Rotary Position Embedding, RoPE）的结构特性，将查询与键分解为可被舍弃的部分，从而显著降低计算量。实验表明，使用HiSA从零训练的LLM不仅保持甚至提升了性能，同时仅需计算约三分之一的查询-键点积；在推理阶段，该方法显著提升解码速度并减少内存占用。此外，作者还将HiSA扩展至FlashAttention-3内核，支持高效训练与推理。研究进一步揭示，传统密集注意力会自发抑制那些被HiSA舍弃的注意力分量，验证了该方法的合理性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26363
作者: Ambroise Borbely,Mathieu Salzmann,Olivier Verscheure
机构: EPFL(瑞士联邦理工学院); Swiss Data Science Center(瑞士数据科学中心); ETH Zurich(苏黎世联邦理工学院)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Attention in large language models (LLMs) scores every query against every key with a full dot product. We investigate whether this dot product must be computed completely for attention to be effective. We propose Hidden Sparse Attention (HiSA), which keeps the query and key projections intact but only computes a partial dot product, following a static, parameter-free rule set by the token positions: attention becomes sparse in the hidden (feature) dimension, an axis much less explored than token sparsity, rather than over tokens as in almost all sparse attention methods. Based on the structure of rotary position embeddings (RoPE), we decompose keys and queries into parts which can be omitted when computing attention. By training LLMs from scratch with HiSA, we find that this partial dot product does not hurt but improves performance compared with the complete product while computing only about a third of the query-key products. During inference HiSA improves decoding speed and shrinks memory footprint. We also extend HiSA to FlashAttention-3 kernels for training and inference. Finally, we motivate our approach by showing that dense attention learns to suppress the attention score parts that HiSA drops. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-8] Beam Model Technical Report

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在代码生成、推理及代理任务中计算效率低、推理成本高且安全性与可控性不足的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在保持前沿性能的同时，显著降低推理阶段的计算开销，并提升对有害请求的拒绝能力。解决方案的关键在于：首先，采用稀疏混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）架构，实现501.3B总参数量下仅23.4B活跃参数的高效计算；其次，通过创新的两阶段中段训练（midtraining phase）实现100万令牌上下文窗口，结合可验证、正确性锚定的数据进行预训练；第三，构建大规模异步强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）系统，在10.5K GB300 GPU上运行4周，生成超1亿次轨迹，显著提升了模型在复杂任务中的表现并持续受益于增加的RL算力；最后，依托软硬件协同设计、FP8/NVFP4量化技术以及一个19.3亿参数的推测解码起草器（DFlash 2），实现了高效的部署与高吞吐服务。实验表明，Beam在各类评估中对有害请求的拒绝/转向率达到88.9%，同时对无害请求的合规率为81.5%，是当前开源权重模型中在帕累托前沿上表现最优的安全性与性能平衡者。

Abstract:Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.

[NLP-9] One Framework to Diagnose Them All: A Stratified Benchmark for Bengali LLM Hallucination WWW EACL2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决低资源语言中幻觉（hallucination）研究碎片化的问题，即每一种新识别出的错误模式都催生独立的数据集，导致标注资源分散且不可比。其核心解决方案是通过大规模社区协作实现基准统一化，提出Alikbachan——一个针对孟加拉语的幻觉检测基准，该基准在三个交叉维度上进行分层：经人工验证的文化距离带、六类任务类型以及涵盖五大家族32种模式的幻觉分类体系。该基准包含两个阶段的数据集：第一阶段为采集的2,516个样本测试集，第二阶段为按配额构建并由黄金标注的5,000个样本集。分层设计具有诊断意义：零样本大语言模型（LLM）判别器在不同分层间的表现差异超过30个宏观F1点，且99个第一阶段与32个第二阶段参赛系统在个体样本上的预测结果重现了这一分布特征——话语层面的遗漏是判别器和多数团队共同面临的挑战，而对负向控制样本的误报率则普遍较低。尽管判别器的置信度评分在项目排序上表现良好（ROC-AUC 0.74–0.95），但存在明显过度自信问题（ECE 0.04–0.29）。在开放竞赛中，共有222支队伍提交3,566次提交，单提示32B规模判别器达到第57百分位。值得注意的是，在两阶段均参与的25支队伍中，24支在第二阶段性能显著下降（平均-17.6分），而所有零样本判别器均表现出提升，且第一阶段排名与第二阶段排名相关性极弱（Spearman ρ=0.35），表明仅依赖第一阶段排行榜将得出错误的优胜者判定。因此，本研究的关键在于通过结构化、可扩展且具备跨域诊断能力的统一基准，推动低资源语言幻觉评估的标准化与可比性。

Abstract:Hallucination research in low-resource languages fragments easily: each newly named failure mode prompts its own dataset, spending scarce annotators on incomparable resources. We argue for consolidation and test it at community scale. Alikbachan is a Bengali hallucination-detection benchmark stratified along three crossed axes: a human-validated cultural-distance band, six task types, and a five-family, 32-mode hallucination taxonomy. It comprises a harvested 2,516-item test set (Phase 1) and a quota-constructed, gold-labeled 5,000-item set (Phase 2). The stratification is diagnostic. Four zero-shot LLM judges vary by over 30 macro-F1 points across strata, and the item-level predictions of 99 Phase-1 and 32 Phase-2 competition systems reproduce the profile: discourse-level omission defeats judges and most teams alike, whereas only a minority over-flag negative controls. The judges’ verdict probabilities rank items well (ROC-AUC 0.74-0.95) but are overconfident (ECE 0.04-0.29). An open competition on Alikbachan drew 222 teams and 3,566 submissions, and a single-prompt 32B judge reaches the 57th percentile. Of the 25 teams in both phases, 24 regress on Phase 2 (mean -17.6 points) while every zero-shot judge improves, and Phase-1 rank barely predicts Phase-2 rank (Spearman \rho=0.35 ), so a Phase-1 leaderboard alone would have crowned a different winner.

[NLP-10] Language-Oriented Semantic Modeling for Target Language Extraction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言语音混合场景下目标语言语音提取（Target Language Extraction, TLE）的难题，现有方法主要依赖带有语言身份标签的声学建模，仅提供粗粒度的类别指引，难以充分捕捉目标语言的语义特征。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种面向语言的语义建模框架，通过引入语言特定的语义表征来增强声学提取过程。具体而言，利用预训练的语音语义模型，结合语言感知提示（language-aware prompt）与参数高效微调技术，从混合语音中生成聚焦于目标语言的高阶语义表示。这些语义表示能够捕捉声学信号中的高层语义结构，并作为结构化语义引导融入提取模型，超越传统语言身份标签的限制。实验在CommonVoiceMix数据集上验证了该方法的有效性，相较于仅依赖声学信息的基线模型，显著提升了语音分离性能，最高实现1.16 dB的SI-SDR增益。

作者: Mehmet Sinan Yıldırım,Ke Zhang,Shuai Wang,Haizhou Li

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Target Language Extraction (TLE) aims to isolate speech in a target language from multilingual mixtures. Existing approaches primarily rely on acoustic modeling with language identity labels, which provide only coarse categorical guidance. In this work, we propose a language-oriented semantic modeling framework that augments acoustic extraction with language-specific semantic representations. A pre-trained speech semantic model is adapted via language-aware prompt conditioning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning to generate target-language-focused semantic representations from the mixture. These capture high-level semantic structure of the acoustics and they are integrated into the extraction model to provide structured semantic guidance beyond identity labels. Experiments on the CommonVoiceMix dataset show that incorporating semantic representations consistently improves over acoustic-only baselines, achieving up to 1.16 dB SI-SDR gain.

[NLP-11] BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决单目摄像头在实时延迟约束下实现高精度自动驾驶决策与预测的挑战，核心问题是如何仅依赖单一前向摄像头，在低于50毫秒的实时响应时间内，完成对当前车速、已行驶路径、碰撞风险评分及未来6.4秒内六种候选轨迹的联合预测。其解决方案的关键在于提出BADAS-3.0——一个拥有10亿参数（1B-parameter）的视频编码器，配备四个轻量级输出头，通过高效架构设计实现了对单路视频流的多任务端到端建模。该模型在未训练过的多摄像头传感器配置上展现出显著优势，表明其具备更强的泛化能力；而在共享的相同传感器配置下性能与更大规模模型（如34B参数的Alpamayo 2 Super）相当。为更真实评估模型安全性，研究引入两个开环安全基准测试：基于真实行车记录仪的碰撞与近事故数据集，以及欧洲新车安全评鉴协会（Euro NCAP）典型场景库，结果表明BADAS-3.0在两项测试中的通过率均优于所有对比的公开发布规划器，验证了其在复杂安全场景下的鲁棒性与实用性。

作者: Roni Goldshmidt,Hamish Scott,Lorenzo Niccolini
机构: Empiric Earth( empiric earth)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads. From two seconds of one forward camera, it predicts the current speed, the metric path just driven, a collision-risk score and six candidate futures over 6.4 seconds, in under 50 ms. Given the car’s current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE _6 over five trajectory benchmarks than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras and runs over 100x slower. The gain comes from camera rigs that neither model was trained on. On the rig they share, the two are on par. Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, so we add two open-loop safety benchmarks, one of real dashcam collisions and near-misses and one of Euro NCAP scenarios. On both, BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than every published planner we tested.

[NLP-12] wice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决学术同行评审中评阅意见多样性下降的问题，特别是评估生成式人工智能（Generative AI）介入对评审意见重叠度的影响。其核心发现表明，近年来顶级会议（如ICLR、NeurIPS、ICML）及期刊（如F1000、PLOS）的评审意见重叠率持续上升，例如ICLR的评审重叠率从2026年的12.0%增至2027年的21.3%，且新增评审所贡献的新问题数量逐年减少，反映出评审意见趋同趋势加剧。为探究这一现象的成因，研究引入MELD（一种检测大语言模型生成文本的工具）对评审内容进行分析，结果显示被标记为可能由大语言模型生成的评审之间，其内容重叠程度显著高于未被标记的评审：在ICLR 2024–2025年期间高出3.0分，在2026–2027年期间高出4.5分，跨五种期刊来源平均高出5.4分。这一结果揭示出，被识别为大语言模型生成的评审意见在语义和内容上更趋一致，从而削弱了多评阅人之间的批判性差异，表明生成式AI的广泛应用正在实质性降低同行评审中应有的多样性与独立性。因此，解决方案的关键在于通过技术手段（如MELD）识别并区分由大语言模型辅助或生成的评审文本，以恢复和保障评审过程的独立性与多样性。

Abstract:Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.

[NLP-13] What If Chain-of-Thought Is Not Enough?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在推理过程中依赖提示工程（prompting-based methods）导致的不可靠性和可解释性不足问题，探索是否可通过训练使模型内部的思考模式（internal thinking model）发生可控且有益的改变。其核心解决方案是引入一种名为“问题-选项-标准”（Question–Option–Criteria, QOC）的结构化决策流程，通过将任务分解为明确的问题、竞争性选项和评估标准，实现对模型内部推理过程的显式引导与优化。研究提出了一套三阶段发展范式，从基础的QOC决策核心逐步演进至具备答案综合与统计增强能力的推理系统，并通过实验证明：相较于未经微调的基础模型，基于QOC的微调显著提升了输出质量，尤其在模型规模足够大、能够稳定执行QOC计算时，性能增益尤为显著。结果表明，大语言模型的内部思考模式具有可训练性，而QOC等结构化推理框架为实现更可靠、可解释且任务适配的决策支持提供了有效路径。

机构: University of Applied Sciences Ruhr West (鲁尔西应用技术大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Reasoning capabilities in large language models have evolved from prompting-based methods to internalized model behaviors. In this paper, we investigate whether the internal thinking model of an LLM can be deliberately changed and whether such a change is beneficial. Instead of relying on Chain-of-Thought, we train models to follow Question–Option–Criteria (QOC), a structured decision process that decomposes a task into explicit questions, competing options, and evaluation criteria. We present a three-generation development pipeline that ranges from a basic QOC decision core to richer answer synthesis and statistically enriched QOC reasoning. We then evaluate the resulting models with respect to both internal consistency and output quality. Across the reported experiments, QOC-based fine-tuning improves answer quality relative to non-fine-tuned base models and yields particularly strong gains once models are large enough to execute the underlying QOC computations reliably. The results suggest that the internal thinking model of an LLM is trainable and that structured alternatives to Chain-of-Thought can provide a promising path toward more reliable, interpretable, and task-adapted decision support.

[NLP-14] dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, DLMs）在生成过程中因依赖大量去噪步骤而导致效率低下的问题。尽管DLM具备并行生成能力，但其每步仅能可靠地提交少量词元（token），主要受限于当前去噪前向传播中提示信息、已提交词元与未提交位置之间的信息整合不充分，导致部分预测尚未充分优化即被决策提交，从而影响生成质量。现有加速方法多聚焦于优化置信度学习或提交策略，但这些方法仅作用于单次去噪输出，无法从根本上改善未提交位置的潜在表示。为此，本文提出dLoop，将预训练的DLM重构为“前奏-循环-尾声”（Prelude-Loop-Coda）架构，并通过参数共享的中间模块对同一部分掩码状态进行多次递归计算。不同于传统去噪推进，每次循环实质上是进一步执行潜空间计算，使分散于未提交位置的信息持续交互并更充分融合，从而提升提交前的表示质量。实验表明，dLoop在GSM8K、MATH、MBPP和HumanEval四个基准测试中均达到最高或并列最高准确率；在考虑循环计算开销后的每前向传递词元数（Tokens Per Forward Pass, TPF）指标下，其性能优于Fast-dLLM、dParallel及d3LLM，在准确率与TPF双指标上均无其他方法能同时超越。机制分析揭示，额外循环主要提升缓慢且不稳定的生成轨迹表现，且未提交位置的更新驱动了后续词元决策的变化。因此，提交前的潜空间计算显著增强了预测可靠性，为DLM加速提供了一种区别于通过训练损失强制提高置信度的新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26275
作者: Handa Li,Pengxiang Li,Mingyu Cao,Xilu Wang,Li Shen,Da Li,Lu Yin
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Diffusion language models (DLMs) support parallel generation, yet they often require many denoising steps because only a fraction of token predictions are sufficiently reliable to be committed at each step. Existing acceleration methods primarily optimize confidence learning or commitment policies. However, these approaches operate on the outputs of a single denoising forward pass, in which information from the prompt, previously committed tokens, and uncommitted positions may not yet be fully integrated. Consequently, some predictions remain under-refined when the commitment decision is made, and modifying the commitment policy alone cannot improve their underlying representations. We introduce dLoop, which restructures a pretrained diffusion language model into a Prelude-Loop-Coda architecture and recurrently applies a parameter-shared intermediate block to the same partially masked state. Rather than advancing the denoising process, each additional loop provides further latent computation, allowing information distributed across uncommitted positions to continue interacting and become more fully integrated before commitment. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH, MBPP, and HumanEval show that dLoop achieves the highest or tied-highest accuracy on every benchmark. With tokens per forward pass (TPF) adjusted for loop computation, it outperforms Fast-dLLM in both accuracy and TPF on all four benchmarks and dParallel on three, and is more accurate than d3LLM on all four, while d3LLM attains higher TPF; no compared method surpasses dLoop in both. Mechanistic analyses show that extra loops mainly help on slow, unstable trajectories and that updates at uncommitted positions drive changes in token decisions and later generation. Pre-commitment latent computation thus makes predictions more reliable, offering a route to DLM acceleration distinct from forcing confidence through the training loss.

[NLP-15] STAGE: Spatio-Temporal Augmented Graph Expansion for Weakly Supervised Cross-Tweet Event Causality Discovery

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决灾难相关社交媒体中因果关系跨越独立推文导致跨推文因果发现难以实现规模化监督与建模的问题。其核心挑战在于，灾害事件的因果链条常分散在多个语义关联但时空分离的推文中，传统依赖局部标注的方法难以捕捉全局因果结构。为此，论文提出STAGE框架，其解决方案的关键在于将可扩展的跨推文弱监督构建与事件发生的时间-空间关系学习解耦：首先基于局部因果种子检索跨推文的语义相关事件实例，并通过因果评分器生成弱标签的跨推文配对；这些配对作为监督信号，驱动一个基于多头图注意力网络（multi-head Graph Attention Network）的模型，该模型在语义增强的事件表示和时空上下文图上进行联合学习。实验表明，相较于仅使用局部监督，所构建的跨推文监督使加州山火数据集的AUPRC提升0.340，哈维飓风数据集提升0.107；在域内测试中，山火任务获得0.885的AUROC，飓风任务达0.710。跨灾种实验揭示了非对称迁移现象，凸显模型对数据集特异性时空偏移的高度敏感性。结果验证了大规模跨推文弱监督与关系化事件建模相结合在碎片化灾情报告中实现因果学习的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26255
作者: Hieu Minh Duong,Todd Gary,Eugene Levin,Long Nguyen
机构: University of Louisville (路易斯维尔大学); Meharry Medical College (梅纳里医学学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Causal relations in disaster-related social media of- ten span independent posts, making cross-tweet causal discovery difficult to supervise and model at scale. We propose STAGE, a framework that separates scalable cross-tweet weak-supervision construction from spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences. Starting from local causal seeds, STAGE retrieves semantically related event occurrences across tweets and uses a causal scorer to construct weakly labeled cross-tweet pairs. These pairs supervise a multi-head Graph Attention Network over semantically enriched event representations and a spatio- temporal context graph. We evaluate STAGE on California Wildfire and Hurricane Harvey using human-gold cross-tweet test sets and 15 baselines. Compared with local-only supervision, the constructed cross-tweet supervision improves STAGE AUPRC by 0.340 on Wildfire and 0.107 on Hurricane. STAGE achieves in-domain AUROC of 0.885 on Wildfire and 0.710 on Hurricane. Cross-disaster experiments reveal asymmetric transfer, highlighting sensitivity to dataset-specific spatio-temporal shifts. These results demonstrate the value of scalable cross-tweet supervision combined with relational event modeling for causal learning across fragmented disaster reports.

[NLP-16] winLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agent ic Twins of Real Labs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前AI代理在科学实验中自主设计与执行实验能力评估的空白问题，尤其聚焦于第三类开放性能力——即自主设计实验并可靠执行的能力。现有基准主要局限于对计算工作流正确执行及从预定义候选集中选择下一步测量的能力评估，而无法真实检验代理在物理或生命科学实验室中自主设计并完成实验的能力。为此，本文提出TwinLab-Bench，一个面向物理科学、生命科学和工程领域52个真实实验任务的基准测试平台，支持超过100种实验操作类型。其核心创新在于引入“孪生实验代理”（TwinLab agent）作为环境执行者，能够基于真实实验室记录读取原始材料、调用由历史数据构建的计算器，并准确执行由被测代理设计的实验流程。通过与隐藏的真实实验记录比对，对代理报告进行评分，从而实现对自主实验设计能力的严格评估。相比仅依赖任务描述的语言模型，TwinLab代理显著减少了与真实记录偏差的读数及重复请求不一致的答案，且通过闭卷探测排除了记忆召回的影响。实验结果表明，即使是最先进的模型如Claude Fable 5.2，在该基准上平均得分仅为45.0，揭示了当前前沿模型在自主实验设计方面仍面临巨大挑战，研究进一步揭示了其失败的关键环节。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26248
作者: Yang Wan,Linchao Zhu
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: this https URL contains tasks and code. 33 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. LLM-agent benchmark for autonomous experimental design in digital twins of real labs (physics, chemistry, wet-lab biology, materials, engineering). 13 agents evaluated: Claude Fable 5.2 45.0, Opus 5.5 40.2, GPT-6.1-sol 31.7, plus DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and others

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI agents are increasingly expected to act as AI scientists, which requires three increasingly open abilities: carrying out a given computational workflow correctly, choosing the next measurements from a given design space, and designing their own experiments. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate the first two abilities, in a terminal or in a closed loop that selects from predefined candidates. Evaluating the third ability requires reliably executing an experiment that an agent designs, with readings grounded in a real laboratory. We introduce TwinLab-Bench, which evaluates AI scientists on self-designed experiments in 52 tasks from laboratories in the physical sciences, the life sciences, and engineering. The benchmark supports more than 100 experimental action types, and the agent’s report is scored by comparison with a hidden answer taken from real laboratory records. Each task has its own TwinLab agent, an agent that serves as the environment and executes the experiments that the tested agent designs, reading the raw materials of the laboratory and calling calculators that are built from its records. Compared with a language model that sees only the task description, the TwinLab agent almost eliminates readings that deviate from the real records and inconsistent answers to a repeated request, and closed-book probes control for answers recalled from memory. We find that these tasks remain hard for frontier models: the strongest, Claude Fable 5.2, averages a score of only 45.0, and we conduct an empirical study of where it fails.

[NLP-17] Frontier models need only one text to unmask its human or AI author

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式内容溯源（authorship attribution）问题，即在无外部工具、候选列表或样本支持的零样本条件下，判断一段文本是由人类还是大模型撰写，并进一步精确识别作者身份。其核心挑战在于，随着生成式AI（Generative AI）模型在训练数据中广泛覆盖公开写作内容，模型不仅具备强大的语言模仿能力，还能通过内部表征对作者风格进行高精度反推。解决方案的关键在于：前沿模型（如Claude Fable 5.2、GPT-6.1 Sol、Gemini 4 Carbon和Opus 5.5）利用其在大规模预训练数据中对特定作者写作风格的隐式学习，结合推理过程中的自我感知机制（例如询问模型对某作者的熟悉程度），实现对作者身份的精准识别。实验表明，这些模型在识别公开同行评审文章作者方面准确率达39%（Nature期刊子集达78%），并能以69%准确率关联活跃Reddit用户的用户名，揭示了当前生成式AI在匿名性保护方面的严重漏洞。该研究强调，模型的识别准确率高度依赖于其在预训练阶段对目标作者写作风格的暴露程度以及推理深度，且现有防御手段极为有限，标志着生成式AI对数字身份隐私构成前所未有的威胁。

作者: Atrey Desai,Deniz Böloni-Turgut,Ty Brassington,Minjoon Choi,Jenna Russell,Rishanth Rajendhran,Bradley Emi,Hila Gonen,Hal Daumé III,John Wieting,Marzena Karpinska,Mohit Iyyer
机构: University of Maryland(马里兰大学); Simon Fraser University(西蒙菲莎大学); Pangram Labs; University of British Columbia(不列颠哥伦比亚大学); Google DeepMind(谷歌深度思维)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Given a single text and a simple zero-shot prompt (no web access, tools, candidate lists, or writing samples), frontier models can answer “who wrote this?” at three increasingly specific levels: (1) whether an AI or human wrote it, (2) if an AI, which lab, and (3) if a human, often exactly who. The latest models (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Carbon) match trained detectors like Pangram while also explaining their predictions in natural language, and Opus 5.5 names the correct lab for 98% of texts generated by models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Most strikingly, Fable 5.2 correctly names the author of 39% of public peer reviews published in Oct-Nov 2026 (78% on a subset of reviews from Nature), and identifies the username behind 69% of comments from active Redditors (with 500 posts over the last year). Accuracy depends on exposure to an author’s writing in pretraining data and on reasoning effort, and simply asking a model how familiar it is with someone predicts whether it can identify their writing. For anyone who has published enough writing online, frontier models present a greater threat to anonymity than commonly assumed, and defenses are limited.

[NLP-18] Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式视觉语言模型在采用“以图像思维”（Thinking with Images, TwI）策略时出现的工具使用不忠实问题，即模型虽频繁调用缩放工具，却并未真正依赖所聚焦的细粒度视觉区域进行推理，导致推理过程缺乏可解释性与可靠性。其核心解决方案在于动态调整训练数据以匹配模型能力的演化：通过构建一个数据合成管道，精准定位小物体并设计可验证的细粒度问题，确保正确缩放后的证据对模型作答仍具关键作用；同时引入自适应奖励机制，在无需缩放时鼓励模型放弃工具使用，从而强化工具使用的必要性与真实性。实验表明，该方法显著提升了推理的忠实性，并在视觉搜索基准（如V*、HR-Bench 4K/8K）及多模态幻觉检测基准上均达到领先性能，证明了通过优化训练数据即可同时提升准确率与推理可信度，无需直接监督推理过程。

作者: Yu Zhao,Jiaxin Zhang,Rohit Saxena,Fazl Barez,Pasquale Minervini,Yiwen Guo
机构: University of Edinburgh(爱丁堡大学); LIGHTSPEED; University of Oxford(牛津大学); Miniml.AI; Independent Researcher
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. To keep zooming useful throughout training, we adapt the training data to the model’s evolving capability and train on questions where correct zoomed evidence can still help the model answer correctly. This selection is supported by a data synthesis pipeline that localises small objects and constructs verifiable questions about their fine details, and complemented by an adaptiveness reward that favours tool-free answers when zooming is unnecessary. The experimental results show that our method substantially improves reasoning faithfulness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual search benchmarks (+11.6% on V*, +7.9% on HR-Bench 4K, and +9.4% on HR-Bench 8K). On multimodal hallucination benchmarks, our model also outperforms the compared TwI baselines. These results suggest that improving TwI faithfulness does not sacrifice accuracy and that both can be learnt from the right training data without directly supervising the reasoning process.

[NLP-19] Can World Models Predict Rice Growth? Toward Agricultural World Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决农业场景下长期作物生长状态的预测问题，即如何基于单张植物图像、其品种信息及拍摄视角，准确预测作物在未来数周至数月后的形态变化（如水稻是否已抽穗、成熟时外观如何）。现有生成式图像模型在该任务中表现不佳，主要因未能充分理解植物当前发育阶段，导致生成结果在生长量、颜色或形态上与实际生长阶段不符。其核心解决方案是提出一种农业世界模型（AgroWM），其关键在于引入“发育推理—生成”双阶段框架：首先通过名为PhenoClock的推理模块，基于输入图像推断当前生长阶段并预测未来阶段，生成包含高度、植株面积和颜色等数值目标的“生长脚本”；随后由“根植渲染器”（Rooted Renderer）模块依据该脚本对原始图像进行精准编辑，添加新器官与颜色变化。为避免模型倾向于输出与原图无差别的结果，采用基于真实后续图像的性状与发育时序验证机制。实验表明，在水稻和玉米两种不同作物上，AgroWM在多个评价指标上显著优于主流生成模型及领域特定基线，尤其在9至20周的长期预测中仍保持优越性能，验证了其在农业世界建模中的有效性。

作者: Wenkai Ji,Zeteng Li,Yinkun Guo,Jie Zhou,Liang He,Zhenong Jin
机构: East China Normal University (华东师范大学); Peking University (北京大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:World models can imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, but growers need to know how a crop will develop over weeks to months: will this rice plant have headed a month from now, and how will it look at harvest? We introduce agricultural world modeling, the task of predicting how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months, from one photo of it, its cultivar, and its camera view. In preliminary analysis, even state-of-the-art image generators get this wrong: they often grow the plant too little or give it the color and form of the wrong growth stage. We argue that they do not work out the plant’s developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. We therefore propose AgroWM, which reasons about development before it draws growth. Its reasoning module, PhenoClock, works out the current growth stage, predicts the future one, and writes a Growth Script with numeric targets for height, plant area, and color; its generation module, the Rooted Renderer, then edits the photo to follow this script, adding new organs and colors to the photographed plant. Because pixel scores can prefer an unchanged copy of the photo, we instead check each forecast’s traits and developmental timing against the plant’s own later photos. On rice, 54.6% of the forecasts of AgroWM are matched to the target stage (Stage R@1), against 34.8% for GPT Image 2.5, 24.0% for Qwen Image 2.1, and 47.4% for the strongest domain-specific baseline, the same backbone fine-tuned without Growth Scripts; 9 to 20 weeks ahead, it still reaches 46.4%, against 35.7% for that baseline. On maize, a crop with a different body plan and stage scale, the same design again scores best on all four measures.

[NLP-20] RL Can Only Reinforce What It Sees Succeed

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在已知规则失效时，强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）系统如何在先验知识与新观测之间进行权衡的问题。其核心挑战在于：当正确行为在训练中极为罕见时，标准的基于结果奖励的强化学习难以有效捕捉并推广这一行为。论文提出的关键解决方案是，通过分析在特定任务中成功执行正确动作的“尝试组”（attempt groups）的预期数量来预测模型是否能够成功学习该行为。研究发现，当预期的获胜尝试组数量约为35时，模型有约50%的概率成功学习到该行为；这一阈值在不同问题类型、重复实验、尝试组规模（4至256次）、学习率、优化器、近端策略优化（GRPO）变体及模型规模（1.3M至85M参数）下均保持稳定，仅影响阈值位置而不改变计数逻辑。因此，该方法的关键在于以“预期成功尝试组数”作为可预测的先验指标，指导对稀疏奖励环境下强化学习性能的评估与设计。
